properties.name: size
properties.description: Sets the visual size. Inherits from the surrounding typography when omitted.

design.name: 🔀 Size
design.note: The code sets no prop default and inherits the size from the surrounding typography instead, which resolves to md in a default context.

properties.name: fontWeight
properties.description: Sets the font variant: `black` is weight 900, `regular` is 400.

design.note: Figma does not offer black yet, so the component only covers the regular default there. Inline emphasis in bold or italic is set directly on the text layer.

design.name: ✏️ Text
design.note: Figma carries the content in a text property. In code the content always comes through children, there is no text property.
